entry.name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (exam AI-901)
entry.note: Foundational Microsoft credential. The required exam is now AI-901, and Microsoft states the English version was updated on April 15, 2026 and expects knowledge of Python syntax

covers: fundamental principles of machine learning on Azure
features of computer vision workloads on Azure
features of Natural Language Processing (NLP) workloads on Azure
features of generative AI workloads on Azure
reading.summary: This certification shows that you can describe fundamental AI concepts for building AI solutions with Microsoft Azure software and services.
reading.audience: It is for people who have conceptual knowledge of AI solutions in Azure, foundational technical skills, knowledge of Python coding syntax and programming techniques, and familiarity with Azure resources.
reading.prerequisites: The page states you should have conceptual knowledge of AI solutions in Azure, foundational technical skills, knowledge of Python coding syntax and programming techniques, and familiarity with Azure resources.
